title.en: An Act Establishing a National Science and Technology High School in Barangay San Jose, City of Antipolo, Province of Rizal to Be Known as Antipolo City National Science and Technology High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National Science and Technology High School in Barangay San Jose, City of Antipolo, Province of Rizal to Be Known as Antipolo City National Science and Technology High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Thành phố Khoa học và Công nghệ Antipolo Quốc gia tại Barangay San Jose, Thành phố Antipolo, Tỉnh Rizal, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเมืองวิทยาศาสตร์และเทคโนโลยี Antipolo แห่งชาติ ในบารังไกย์ San Jose เมือง Antipolo จังหวัด Rizal และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Menengah Kota Sains dan Teknologi Antipolo Nasional di Barangay San Jose, Kota Antipolo, Provinsi Rizal, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Bandar Sains dan Teknologi Antipolo Kebangsaan di Barangay San Jose, Bandar Antipolo, Wilayah Rizal, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national science and technology high school in Barangay San Jose, City of Antipolo, Province of Rizal to be known as Antipolo City National Science and Technology High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Antipolo City National Science and Technology High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
